name: cc-cache-warming
description: Keep the main Claude Code session's prompt cache warm for up to 6 hours after your last real task. A background Monitor pings the same session ~48 min after each cache touch, a prompt hook gates every ping (too late, not needed, disabled) and blocks tools during it, and every ping is verified from the transcript's cache_read/cache_creation tokens; misses, rewrites, 5m TTL, model switches and API/quota errors stop it.
